Nibras PIM

Apps from the Nibras PIM project (https://github.com/mhm-fakih/nibras-pim): knotes, plain-text notes with a lecture player, prayer times and sync with your own server. Free software under AGPL-3.0, signed by the author.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://mhm-fakih.github.io/nibras-fdroid/repo
